name: BillingDisputeResolutionDesk
tagline: Telecom bill disputes from intake to credit – charge-line adjustments, delegated credit approvals, SLA and deadlock clocks and root-cause analytics in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete billing-dispute app for telecom operators, MVNOs and ISPs: dashboard, dispute grid, pipeline board, credit approval queue and root-cause analysis. Break a dispute into invoice charge lines and credit them line by line, route credits above an agent's limit through a delegated-authority ladder, hold the disputed amount from collections, watch segment resolution SLAs and the deadlock / ADR period, and spot repeat disputants and systemic billing defects. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped, then connects to a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or SQL table, a model-driven view or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Charge lines with per-line credits and automatic allocation
Delegated credit authority ladder enforced on approval
Status rules with required owner, root cause, credit, resolution, approver and notes
Collections hold applied on investigation and released on resolution
Resolution SLA per segment with at-risk and breach flags
Deadlock / ADR warning, deadlock letter and regulator-referral flag
Repeat-disputant and systemic root-cause detection with revenue assurance review
KPIs: open, disputed amount, awaiting approval, breached, credits 30 d, avg days, upheld %
Bulk assign, queue, collections hold, status and CSV export
Drag-and-drop and keyboard status moves, undo, back/forward, search and filters
controlType: standard (2 controls: BillingDisputeResolutionDesk data-set + BillingDisputeResolutionDeskPortal field)
